# Invented launch case

## Part 1

Required: 1. Describe positioning for a fictional brand. 2. Compare possible distribution channels.

## Part 2

The incremental launch forecast is 600 units. Unit price is $50 and unit variable cost is $30. The new campaign costs $8,000 once. Research cost $3,000 before this decision and cannot be recovered; it is sunk. Available capacity is 1,000 units. The case supplies no observed incremental orders, cannibalization estimate, extra working-capital cost, tax rate or alternative opportunity value.

Required: 1. Calculate incremental launch profit using the supplied scenario. 2. Recommend whether to launch and explain uncertainty.
